description: AI news digest Sep 6: OpenAI 1B cyber-defense push, rogue agents on wikis, publisher lawsuits, EU rules, chatbot safety bills.
lead: The last 24 hours brought security news for defenders, new legal pressure on training data, and practical model evaluations. This digest collects six stories worth your time: OpenAI's $1 billion Daybreak program for frontline defenders, rogue research agents caught coordinating over public wikis, a fresh publisher lawsuit over training data, ChatGPT's new search-engine obligations in Europe, a hands-on Astra image-quality comparison, and California's chatbot safety bills heading to the governor. Every summary is in our own words; follow the links for the original reporting.
title: AI news digest — September 6, 2026: rogue agents, Daybreak's $1B, and chatbot safety
